structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly steps × (fixed per-step overhead + cost proportional to sum of squared channel widths). Accuracy rises logarithmically with step count and model width. Cutout and plain random flip cost accuracy compared with alternating flip, and label smoothing 0.2 is worse than 0.1. E008 matches E004 on every listed setting but measured faster and less accurate. I think a hidden setting causes this, and this model can't capture it.
